title: Glossary
description: The words used in ALERTE, in plain language.

workspace.name: Workspace
workspace.def: An isolated working space for one project, organisation or team. It holds everything: countries, institutions, knowledge bases, mandates, agents, permissions, scenarios, exercises and reports. Two workspaces never see each other's data. It is not a country, a scenario or an exercise.

knowledgeBase.name: Knowledge base (KB)
knowledgeBase.def: A library of documents (laws, decrees, plans, reports) cut into searchable passages. Agents only read the KBs they are granted, and only their published versions.

chunk.name: Chunk (passage)
chunk.def: A piece of a document, usually one article, with its page, article number and language. Searches return chunks, and every citation points to one.

mandate.name: Mandate
mandate.def: A line of the who-does-what map: an institution may or must do an action, with the text that says so. It is written in a text, deduced from a text, or assumed. Only a validated mandate with a resolvable source counts as documented.

registry.name: Registry review
registry.def: A human statement that an institution's list of mandates is complete. Until then, a missing mandate is never presented as a documented gap.

agent.name: Agent
agent.def: A virtual institution: an AI (or a scripted stand-in, labelled NO AI) with a mission, tools and limits. It only knows what its institution would know.

accessMapping.name: Access mapping
accessMapping.def: The agents × knowledge bases grid: which agent may read which base. It is enforced by the server on every search.

scenario.name: Scenario
scenario.def: The crisis story: an ordered list of events (injects). Reusable for any number of exercises.

inject.name: Inject (event)
inject.def: One event of the story: simulated time, sender, recipients, text, what it requires, tags and an optional failure type. It is delivered only to its recipients.

seat.name: Seat
seat.def: One institution's place in an exercise, played by an AI agent or by a named human who receives a personal link.

readiness.name: Readiness
readiness.def: The pre-launch checks of an exercise. A blocking issue prevents launching; a warning lets you launch but is recorded.

exercise.name: Exercise
exercise.def: One run of a scenario with a given set of seats. Its configuration is frozen at launch (a snapshot) and everything that happens is recorded.

gap.name: Gap
gap.def: A hole in the rules found by an explicit rule (G1 to G10), with its evidence. It stays « proposed » until a human confirms, disputes or rejects it.

ledger.name: Ledger (logbook)
ledger.def: The append-only record of the exercise. Each entry carries a fingerprint chained to the previous one, so any alteration is detectable. Tamper-evident, not tamper-proof.

replay.name: Replay
replay.def: Rebuilding any moment of a past exercise from its ledger, without calling any model.

scripted.name: Scripted (NO AI)
scripted.def: A test mode with deterministic answers. It proves the platform works, never that an AI reasons well. It is labelled NO AI everywhere.
